description: This file defines the LeaveStatus entity class for the OrangeHRM human resource management system, representing leave status entries mapped to the ohrm_leave_status database table. It includes properties for id, status, and name, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LeaveStatus
classes.description: Entity class representing the status of a leave entry in the HRM system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave status.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the leave status.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status code for the leave status.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status code for the leave status.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the leave status.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave status.
